# LEXDEN NOVA

> A marketplace for digital products, courses, services and selected physical products, with an affiliate programme.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://lexdendigital.github.io/LEXDEN-NOVA/index.html)
- [All products](https://lexdendigital.github.io/LEXDEN-NOVA/product/)
- [Feed](https://lexdendigital.github.io/LEXDEN-NOVA/feed/)
- [Affiliate programme](https://lexdendigital.github.io/LEXDEN-NOVA/affiliate-program/)
- [Machine-readable catalogue (JSON)](https://lexdendigital.github.io/LEXDEN-NOVA/catalog.json)
- Live read-only API: https://lexden-nova.onrender.com/api/catalog (search with ?q=, filter with ?type=)
- Read-only MCP server (no sign-in, no purchase tools): https://lexden-nova.onrender.com/mcp/public
